Incoming Exchange

California State University Channel Islands offers international exchange students the opportunity to enroll in courses on campus with regular domestic university students. In return, CI students have an opportunity to study at the partner educational institution: Institutional Partners.

Important Dates

Fall 2026 Semester

  • Nomination Deadline: March 15, 2026
  • Application Deadline: April 1, 2026
  • Class Schedule Available: April 2, 2026
  • Day to Arrive in Camarillo: August 19, 2026
  • International Orientation: August 20, 2026
  • Classes Start: August 24, 2026
  • Final Examination week (end of the semester) - December 7-12, 2026

Spring 2027 Semester

  • Nomination Deadline: October 1, 2026
  • Application Deadline: October 15, 2026
  • Class Schedule Available: November 1, 2026
  • Day to Arrive in Camarillo: January 19, 2027
  • International Orientation: January 20, 2027
  • Classes Start: January 25, 2027
  • Final Examination Week (end of the semester): May 17-21, 2027

Admission Requirements

  • To apply for the J-1 Exchange program at CI you must be enrolled at one of our Institutional Partners
  • You must be nominated by your Institution’s International Office
  • Complete J-1 Exchange Application (sent by email after nomination)
  • Verify Financial Support (instructions emailed after nomination)
  • English Proficiency Score (TOEFL-internet based score 61, IELTS 6.0, iTEP5 or DAAD B or better, Eiken Pre-1, PTE 46, Duolingo Academic Test 95)
  • Official Transcripts
  • Provide passport copy (US citizens are not eligible for exchange, contact of other pathways to attend)

Once Admitted

  • Apply for your J-1 visa at US Consulate (instruction is included in your pre-departure packet)
  • Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) is the nearest international airport
  • J-1 status students must provide proof of insurance coverage through United Healthcare.
  • Follow all regulations regarding immunizations, please visit CSU Channel Islands Student Health Center.
  • Please note that specific classes you choose may have a nominal class related fee (e.g. lab fee), if you enroll in these classes you are required to pay the fee related to the specific class.

Campus Housing

Campus housing is available. To learn more visitHousing & Residential Education.
